kristoff--kristoff-cameroon.description: Kristoff Cameroon wraps Dominican and Nicaraguan long filler in an African Cameroon leaf aged for seven years, handmade in the Dominican Republic for Glen Case's brand, founded in 2004. Oak and coffee open the smoke with cherry and white pepper; it ends creamy, with chocolatey sweetness, cinnamon and a floral lift.

thirds.notes: Bold oak with faint dark-roast coffee, a bittersweet cherry note and white pepper.
Coffee sharpens to match the oak, with a woody, mineral retrohale and a buttery touch.
The bitterness fades into creamy, chocolatey sweetness, with cinnamon, cabinet spice and a floral finish.

sources.title: JR Cigars Blending Room – The lineup of Kristoff cigars
Blind Man's Puff – Kristoff Cameroon Robusto

kristoff--kristoff-connecticut.description: Kristoff Connecticut sits at the mild end of Glen Case's range: an Ecuador Connecticut wrapper over balanced Dominican and Nicaraguan long filler, handmade in the Dominican Republic. Mellow and nutty, it shows cashew, almond and toasted grain with soft cedar, a little coffee bean and white pepper; a cigar for the morning.

kristoff--kristoff-corojo-limitada.description: Kristoff Corojo Limitada pairs a Nicaraguan Corojo wrapper and a Nicaraguan Habano binder with Dominican and Nicaraguan long filler grown from Cuban seed, handmade in the Dominican Republic. Pepper, cedar and leather open over an earthy base; the middle turns sweeter and rounder, with honey, tea-like notes and nuts, and the finish grows richer and more roasted.

thirds.notes: Red pepper over cedar and dry earth, with leather on the retrohale and an early creamy sweetness.
The pepper recedes; honey, nutty notes and tea-like tannins appear alongside wood and leather.
The flavours gather into a richer, roasted close with caramel sweetness and lingering herbal spice.

sources.title: Klaro Cigars – Kristoff Corojo Limitada review
Cigar Reviews by the Katman – Kristoff Corojo Limitada

kristoff--kristoff-criollo.description: Kristoff Criollo, part of the brand's core range, uses a Cuban-seed Nicaraguan Criollo wrapper over Dominican-based long filler, handmade in the Dominican Republic. Retail descriptions point to chestnut, cashew and cedar with black pepper, alongside a sweet almond and cocoa character; a measured, nutty smoke for an unhurried hour.

kristoff--kristoff-gc-signature-series.description: The GC Signature Series sets a Brazilian maduro wrapper over Cuban-seed filler from the Dominican Republic, Honduras and Nicaragua, made for Kristoff at the Charles Fairmorn factory in the Dominican Republic. Pepper and espresso lead into dark chocolate, roasted nuts and dried fruit, with leather and a creamy sweetness as the smoke develops.

thirds.notes: Pepper and espresso up front, settling into wood, roasted nuts and dark chocolate with a little dried fruit.
Creamy chocolate sweetness thickens, with leather, cinnamon and pepper lingering between puffs.
Chocolate and dried fruit stay in front with leather and earth; hazelnut appears as the pepper softens.

sources.title: JR Cigars Blending Room – The lineup of Kristoff cigars
Blind Man's Puff – Kristoff GC Signature Series Robusto
Cigar Inspector – Kristoff GC Signature Series Robusto

kristoff--kristoff-habano.description: Kristoff Habano wraps Dominican and Nicaraguan long filler and a Brazilian binder in a dark, oily Cuban-seed wrapper grown in Brazil, handmade in the Dominican Republic. Medium in strength, it moves from wood, white pepper and earth toward cocoa, pecan and cinnamon, spicy on the draw with a sweet finish.

kristoff--kristoff-kristania.description: Kristania pairs a dark Nicaraguan Criollo wrapper with aged Cuban-seed long filler grown in the Dominican Republic, handmade for Kristoff in the Dominican Republic. Cocoa and espresso meet toasted almond, pepper and baking spice, with a hint of vanilla and a creamy, sweet finish; a rich cigar for the evening.

sources.title: JR Cigars Blending Room – The lineup of Kristoff cigars

kristoff--kristoff-kristania-maduro.description: Kristania Maduro replaces the Criollo leaf of the Kristania with a Brazilian maduro wrapper over Cuban-seed Dominican long filler, handmade in the Dominican Republic. Retail notes cite fresh coffee, cocoa, hazelnut and pepper; one review found it gentler and earthier, with damp earth, light pepper and a late turn to dried cherry and bread.

thirds.notes: After a hay-like start, damp, musty earth with a light pepper and a short, clean finish.
Little changes: the earthy core and soft pepper hold steady.
Dried cherry and a subtle sweetness join the earth, and the pepper gives way to a soft, bready finish.

sources.title: JR Cigars Blending Room – The lineup of Kristoff cigars
Cigar Obsession – Kristoff Kristania Maduro Toro review

kristoff--kristoff-ligero-maduro.description: Kristoff Ligero Maduro is the heavier sibling of the brand's Maduro, with a larger share of ligero under an almost black Brazilian maduro wrapper and a Cuban-seed Dominican binder, handmade in the Dominican Republic. Dark cocoa, espresso and sweetness lead with spice and black cherry; cream arrives mid-way and dark chocolate takes over at the end.

thirds.notes: Sweet, dark cocoa with spice, espresso, wood and a black-cherry note, bold if not yet complex.
Creaminess appears and the cocoa grows as the flavours knit together and the nicotine picks up.
Rich tobacco, cream and black cherry, with dark chocolate finally taking the lead.

sources.title: Cigar Reviews by the Katman – Kristoff Ligero Maduro

kristoff--kristoff-maduro.description: Kristoff Maduro, from the brand's core range, uses a Brazilian maduro wrapper over Cuban-seed long filler with a Dominican base, handmade in the Dominican Republic. Medium in strength, it brings a molasses-like sweetness, espresso and dark chocolate with black pepper, earth and cedar, and a faint note of licorice.

kristoff--kristoff-san-andres.description: Kristoff San Andres wraps Nicaraguan filler and a Cuban-seed Ecuadorian binder in a jet-black, oily Mexican San Andrés leaf, handmade in the Dominican Republic. It sits in the medium to full range, with dark-roast coffee and chocolate over earth, leather and black pepper, softened by a creamy note.

sources.title: JR Cigars Blending Room – The lineup of Kristoff cigars

kristoff--kristoff-shade-grown.description: Kristoff Shade Grown uses a Connecticut-seed wrapper grown under shade in Honduras, over a Cuban-seed binder and filler from the Dominican Republic and Nicaragua. Creamy and nutty, it shows bread, leather and cedar with a honeyed texture, turns savoury in the middle, and brings a black-tea note toward the end.

thirds.notes: Creamy and honeyed once the shaggy foot burns off, with roasted nuts, bread, leather and cedar.
Cedar and white pepper come forward with leather and a savoury, cumin-like spice.
Bolder flavours and a deep black-tea note, with nuts, cedar and bread ending on leather.

sources.title: Blind Man's Puff – Kristoff Shade Grown Robusto

kristoff--kristoff-sumatra.description: Kristoff Sumatra pairs an Ecuadorian Sumatra wrapper with a Brazilian binder and Cuban-seed Dominican and Nicaraguan filler, made at the Charles Fairmorn factory in the Dominican Republic. Herbal spice, hardwood and clay-like earth lead; the middle brings nuts, cocoa nibs and an Earl Grey-like tea note, and it closes nutty and gently spiced.

thirds.notes: A leathery, spicy start, then herbal spice, hardwood and clay-like earth with a tea-like note.
Milky nuts, rich earth and cocoa nibs appear before Earl Grey and a cool, minty edge return.
Nutty, mildly spiced and chewy to the finish.

sources.title: Klaro Cigars – Kristoff Sumatra Matador review

kristoff--kristoff-vengeance.description: Kristoff Vengeance wraps Dominican and Nicaraguan filler and an Indonesian binder in a dark, oily Connecticut Broadleaf leaf, made at the Charles Fairmorn factory in the Dominican Republic. Black pepper and dark-roast coffee open with a maduro sweetness, chocolate and cocoa take over the middle, and leather and earth carry the finish.

thirds.notes: Sharp black pepper and dark-roast coffee with ginger-like spice and a pronounced sweetness; leather follows.
The pepper fades and the smoke turns thick and sweet, with dark cocoa over coffee and leather.
Earthy, meaty notes return as leather and chocolate sharpen, with a little cedar near the end.

sources.title: Blind Man's Puff – Kristoff Vengeance Toro
